info.name: AI Support Ticket Router
info.description:
Postman collection for testing the Vitto AI Support Ticket Router n8n workflow.

Endpoints:
- Test mode: https://anantvarma.app.n8n.cloud/webhook-test/support-ticket
- Production: https://anantvarma.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/support-ticket

Usage:
1. Import this file into Postman
2. Set the {{base_url}} variable to your n8n instance
3. Open your workflow in n8n and click 'Listen for test event' on the Webhook node
4. Send any request from this collection

Expected routing: #technical-support
Expected priority: medium

Edge case: vague message that may produce low AI confidence.
If confidence < 0.7, should trigger the fallback path → general queue with needsHumanReview: true

Error case: missing both 'email' and 'message' fields.
Expected: 400 Bad Request with JSON error body.
This tests the Validate Required Fields → Respond 400 branch.

Expected: 400 Bad Request.
Tests null-safe normalization + validation.
